answer: Sequential work auction. Each identity must complete a randomly assigned micro-task (labeling a juniper image, verifying a canyon map tile) before its next action, and the task queue is public. Completing grants one opal credit, spent per transaction. An attacker running 1,000 sybils must complete 1,000 serialized tasks, paying real labor time plus queue delays, capping his throughput to one identity per task cycle.
